LanguageData.NeatEdges.DesignatorExpandDesc: Paint tiles whose edges stay crisp. Terrain stops fading into a painted tile, and the painted tile stops fading into its neighbours.\n\nPainting is free and instant: nothing is built, and nothing is drawn on the map.
LanguageData.NeatEdges.DesignatorClearDesc: Remove tiles from the hard edge area, so their edges fade as normal again. Hard edge markers standing on those tiles keep working.
LanguageData.NeatEdges.SettingTrimsOnMisc: Put the floor borders on the Misc tab
LanguageData.NeatEdges.SettingTrimsOnMiscDesc:
On, the default: the seven floor border buttons sit at the end of the Misc tab. The hard edge marker stays on Floors.

Off: they sit on the Floors tab, among the floors, as before version 1.2.

The buttons move straight away, in a running game too.
LanguageData.NeatEdges.SettingTrimsOnDecorate: Put the floor borders under Decorate, in a Trims section
LanguageData.NeatEdges.SettingTrimsOnDecorateDesc:
On, the default: the seven floor border buttons sit in a Trims section of their own on the Decorate tab, which Neat Edges adds while Better Architect Menu is loaded. The hard edge marker stays on Floors.

Off: they sit on the Floors tab, among the floors, as before version 1.2.

The buttons move straight away, in a running game too.
LanguageData.NeatEdges.WhatsNew_1_2_0_Title: Neat Edges 1.2: the floor borders have moved
LanguageData.NeatEdges.WhatsNew_1_2_0_Decorate:
The seven floor border buttons have left the Floors tab, where they crowded the floors. With Better Architect Menu they have a Trims section of their own on the Decorate tab. The hard edge marker is still on Floors.

To have them among the floors again, press Back to the Floors tab, or untick "{0}" in Neat Edges' mod settings. The box moves them either way at any time, in a running game too.

This note shows only once.
LanguageData.NeatEdges.WhatsNew_1_2_0_Misc:
The seven floor border buttons have left the Floors tab, where they crowded the floors. They are at the end of the Misc tab now. The hard edge marker is still on Floors.

To have them among the floors again, press Back to the Floors tab, or untick "{0}" in Neat Edges' mod settings. The box moves them either way at any time, in a running game too.

This note shows only once.
LanguageData.NeatEdges.OverlayToggle: Show hard edges: every tile with a hard edge marker on it, and the painted hard edge area.
LanguageData.NeatEdges.AdoptedAreas: Neat Edges took over the hard-edged areas you painted with Perspective: Paths. Paint or clear them from the Zone tab of the Architect menu, where its tools were.
LanguageData.NeatEdges.HandedBackAreas: Perspective: Paths is installed, so it took over the hard edge area you painted with Neat Edges. Paint or clear it from the Zone tab of the Architect menu.
